name: heygen-shorts
description: Set up and run an approval-based HeyGen Video Agent to Buffer YouTube Shorts pipeline with a fixed Anshul -- 17 voice.

interface.shortDescription: Topics to approved, captioned YouTube Shorts
interface.longDescription: Guided setup creates a new Google Sheet, discovers avatar looks, verifies Anshul -- 17 and Buffer destination, and configures three approval-based schedulers. Generates through Video Agent only with B-roll, persistent titles and subtitles. Requires your own connected Google Drive, HeyGen and Buffer accounts.
